subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should Discord elevated mode continue to treat `channels.discord.allowFrom` as the fallback when `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` is omitted, or should elevated access require an explicit elevated allowlist going forward?
rationale: Both choices affect the host-exec authorization boundary: restoring the fallback preserves the shipped docs contract, while explicit-only allowlists keep elevated access narrower.

options.title: Restore the released fallback
options.body: Implement the Discord fallback through the channel plugin hook, make `sandbox explain` share that resolver, preserve explicit empty-list override behavior, and add focused tests.

options.title: Retire the fallback explicitly
options.body: Keep elevated authorization explicit-only, update shipped docs/release notes, and close conflicting fallback PRs with the security rationale.

options.title: Decide during PR refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR is rebased, then make the security-contract decision in PR review.

recommendation.title: Restore the released fallback
recommendation.body: Implement the Discord fallback through the channel plugin hook, make `sandbox explain` share that resolver, preserve explicit empty-list override behavior, and add focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest current history across elevated auth, the plugin fallback seam, and sandbox explain.
